scheme_name: Scheme of Internship for Post-Graduate/Research Students
other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India.

Must be pursuing post‑graduation or research in Statistics, Mathematical Statistics, Operational Research, Economics, Demography or any applied field of Statistics from a recognized college, university or research institute.
Internship duration is 2 months from the date of joining.
Interns must submit a report/paper (including soft copy) at the end of the assignment.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a token stipend of ₹10,000 (₹5,000 per month) on successful completion, along with a certificate and basic logistical support.
